layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no clear setups worth risking capital on right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood with Bitcoin drifting down near $63,400 and most altcoins following. The candidates on our watchlist are either stablecoins (no trade opportunity), extremely volatile low-quality tokens (BEAT crashed 46% in a week), or already extended after big runs (CYS up 65% in 7 days). Solana is the strongest quality asset in the group but lacks a clear technical trigger — no RSI reading, no MACD cross, and BTC dominance at 56.3% is squeezing altcoins. In a fear environment with no confirmed setup, sitting on the sidelines protects capital.
layman_action: Wait for a clearer entry. Keep watching Solana for a dip toward $72-73 with a volume spike or RSI oversold signal before committing. Cash is a position too.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is weak this cycle. BEAT (-46% 7d) looks like a capitulation but has an RSI of 51 which is oddly neutral for such a crash — suggesting unreliable data or low liquidity dynamics that make mean-reversion risky. CYS is up 65% in 7 days and pulling back 14% in 24h — classic blow-off top behavior, not a swing entry. FDUSD/RLUSD/USDG are stablecoins. XAUT/PAXG are gold-backed tokens with 2.7-2.8% 7d gains but don't offer swing trade-sized returns. SOL at $75.58 is 74% off ATH and showing mild strength (+3.3% 7d) but with no RSI data, no MACD cross, and high BTC dominance headwind, there's no confirmed entry signal. The Fear & Greed at 29 with flat trend means we haven't reached capitulation levels that historically produce reliable bounces. Disciplined approach: wait for setup confirmation.
risk_factors: Sticky US inflation could push risk assets lower and extend the fear cycle
BTC dominance at 56.3% and rising continues to drain capital from altcoins
No confirmed technical signals (RSI/MACD) on any quality swing candidate
watch_list: SOL price action near $72-73 support — a bounce there with volume would be actionable
Fear & Greed index dropping below 20 (extreme fear) which historically signals better contrarian entries
BTC reaction to $62,000 support — a breakdown there would invalidate all alt setups
market_context: Bitcoin is holding near $63,400 but Glassnode data shows speculators capping price below $68.7K. Sticky inflation readings and high BTC dominance at 56.3% create a risk-off environment unfavorable for altcoin swing trades.
context_banner: Market fear persists without capitulation — disciplined traders wait for confirmed setups rather than forcing entries in a weak candidate pool.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 29 (Fear) with flat trend — not yet at extreme fear levels that historically produce reliable bounce setups.
Glassnode analysis shows Bitcoin speculators keeping BTC price pinned below $68.7K, creating a ceiling that limits upside for the entire market.
US inflation stickier than July's CPI suggests — macro headwind that pressures risk assets and extends the fear cycle.
No volume breakout signals detected on any swing candidate — SOL has $1.2B volume but no unusual spike to confirm a directional move.
Only BEAT has RSI data (51, neutral) which conflicts with its -46% 7d crash. All other candidates lack RSI readings, removing our most reliable signal from the analysis.
